subject: Request for temporary test tokens while vendor onboarding completes
messages:
From: Sarah Nelson <sarah.nelson@evexhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@evexhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Trial access request — temporary test tokens during vendor onboarding

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Evex's ML team loved the throughput profiles. We're excited to move forward, but procurement has put vendor onboarding on a short review cycle and our PO will be delayed by at least a week while legal and security finish their checklist.

We're still running experiments and would really like to preserve the test momentum. Is there any way Redwood can provide a small advance of test tokens or a short trial extension so our engineers can complete the integration smoke tests while the PO is processed? We anticipate the official PO will be issued by 2026-09-29.

I can share the procurement contact if you need to coordinate terms: procurement@evexhealth.com.

Appreciate any flexibility — we want to avoid re-running long setups if the trial lapses.

Thanks,
Sarah Nelson
Product Manager, Evex Health
+sarah.nelson@evexhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

[Attachment: sample-integration-log.txt]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Nelson <sarah.nelson@evexhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Trial access request — temporary test tokens during vendor onboarding

Hi Sarah — thanks for the context and glad the demo went well.

Short answer: yes, we can help. Before I make any formal approvals I need to confirm a couple of operational items. Can you confirm these: 

- Expected PO date (you mentioned 2026-09-29 — is that firm?)
- Any contractual blockers from security/legal we should be aware of (NDA/DPAs outstanding?)

If procurement confirms the PO window, I can provision a temporary bundle of test tokens (good for 10 days) and a short billing hold so usage during that window doesn't incur charges. I'll loop in Marissa for the credit approval and Dylan for billing/finance to place the invoice on hold until the PO arrives.

Next steps:
- Sarah: confirm PO ETA and any outstanding documents
- Me: draft interim credit agreement and get Marissa's sign-off
- Marissa/Dylan: enable tokens and set billing hold once we have agreement

I'll prepare a brief interim agreement so legal has something to review.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Nelson <sarah.nelson@evexhealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Trial access request — temporary test tokens during vendor onboarding

On Tue, Sep 21, 2026 at 18:05, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Sarah — thanks for the context and glad the demo went well.
> 
> Short answer: yes, we can help.

Hi all — I can approve a short interim arrangement to keep the PoC running. 

Proposal (approved):
- Grant 30k test tokens valid for 10 calendar days from provisioning
- Billing hold: any usage during the token window will be recorded but not invoiced; once PO arrives we will apply usage to the PO and invoice normally
- Conditions: Evex must provide a target PO date (we do not need the signed PO to provision tokens, but we need the procurement contact and ETA). If we don't receive a PO or formal reply by the end of the 10-day window, token access will be suspended.

I've attached a short Interim Credit Agreement that outlines the mechanics — please review and let us know if legal needs any edits. Dylan, can you please prepare the billing hold workflow once Sarah confirms the PO ETA?

Attachments: Interim-Credit-Agreement.pdf (1 page, redwood template)

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Marissa / Jordan — thank you, this is perfect and appreciated.

PO ETA: procurement has committed to issuing the PO by 2026-09-29 EOD. Legal has one minor redline to the standard DPA which should be resolved before the PO is sent; I'll forward any comments this afternoon.

We accept the proposed conditions and would like the tokens provisioned the morning of 2026-09-25 if possible (our engineers have a larger test scheduled then). If the PO timeline slips we will notify you immediately.

I've CC'd Sam (ops lead) and procurement so they can track the interim agreement.

Thanks again — this will save the team a couple days of rework.

Best,
Sarah Nelson
Product Manager, Evex Health
